summary: Mechanics Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Mechanics Bank, completed the sale of approximately $417 million of remaining performing indirect auto loans to Bank of America's trading desk. The price was near book value, with a cutoff date of August 31, 2026; Mechanics Bank retains roughly $13 million of runoff auto loans. Westlake Portfolio Management continues servicing loans for both parties. Management framed the deal as balance-sheet optimization and capital reallocation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed, as this was an asset sale rather than a whole-company transaction.
